bugs.title: The Frozen Counter
bugs.description: This function should count to 5, but it freezes the browser. Fix the bug.
hints: Look at the while loop condition
bugs.explanation: The loop variable 'i' is never incremented, so i < 5 is always true, causing an infinite loop. Adding i++ fixes it.

bugs.title: Variable Vanishing Act
bugs.description: This function should calculate the total, but it throws an error. Fix the scoping issue.
hints: Declare tax before the if statement
bugs.explanation: The variable 'tax' is declared inside the if block with 'let', making it block-scoped. It's not accessible outside the block. Move the declaration before the if.

bugs.title: Array Access Error
bugs.description: This function should return the last element, but it crashes. Fix the off-by-one error.
hints: What's the index of the last element in [1,2,3]?
bugs.explanation: Array indices are 0-based. For an array of length 3, valid indices are 0, 1, 2. arr[arr.length] accesses index 3 which is undefined.

bugs.title: Python Indentation
bugs.description: This Python function has an indentation error. Fix it to make it work.
hints: Python uses indentation for code blocks
The return statement needs to be indented
bugs.explanation: Python requires consistent indentation. The return statement must be indented to be inside the function definition.

bugs.title: Type Confusion
bugs.description: This function should check if input is exactly 0, but it returns true for empty strings. Fix the comparison.
bugs.explanation: The == operator performs type coercion, so '' == 0 is true. Use === for strict equality which checks both value and type.
